image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured brown surface. The bib features an orange fabric with a raised bubble/dot texture (minky style) and white stitching around the edges. It has a curved neck opening with a beige/tan fabric trim. There is a decorative pocket or flap on the right side made of orange and white striped fabric, secured with dark brown button-like details that resemble eyes or snaps. The overall shape is irregular but generally shield-like.
